image.name: odq-gnome
image.software_renderer: Mesa llvmpipe via GALLIUM_DRIVER=llvmpipe; unset LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE for native Wayland EGL
limitations: The image fingerprint pins the base only. GNOME 46 family packages come from Ubuntu noble apt repositories at provisioning time; exact installed versions must be captured by smoke evidence.

No tray extensions installed or enabled; dconf pins enabled-extensions to an empty typed string array and disables user extensions. The GNOME Wayland-only session name, GDM WaylandEnable and AccountsService SessionType are preferences, not proof: smoke rejects X11 fallback.

gnome-screenshot is attempted in the guest user session, then GNOME Shell Screenshot D-Bus. Wayland caller restrictions may reject capture; no unsafe Shell mode, caller-name spoof or XWayland-only capture is used. Failure produces no screenshot proof.

Virtual software rendering exercises desktop/session/protocol behavior, not physical GPU/display performance, hardware input/audio, multi-monitor fidelity or passthrough. No host GPU device is requested.
Runtime smoke observations and the native EGL renderer fix are recorded in maintenance/phase3-lab.md, not here.
